title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
title_zh: EvoCodeAgent：通过架构-代码协同演进与经验引导修复实现项目级代码生成

paragraphs.en: EvoCodeAgent通过架构-代码协同演进与经验复用，在项目级代码生成基准上显著超越基线。 Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.
paragraphs.zh: EvoCodeAgent通过架构-代码协同演进与经验复用，在项目级代码生成基准上显著超越基线。项目级代码生成旨在从高层需求自动合成完整的软件仓库，生成具有结构良好模块和一致跨文件依赖的连贯多文件系统。 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在规范理解和代码合成方面能力强大，现有方法仍存在若干关键局限。 首先，许多方法依赖静态架构设计，无法在迭代生成过程中进行调整，导致架构与实现之间的偏差不断扩大。 其次，它们缺乏跨迭代积累和复用经验的机制，导致错误反复出现且效率降低。 第三，它们通常依赖基于LLM的独立评估来评价中间产物，这种方式透明度有限，且在长上下文推理下可能不可靠。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EvoCodeAgent，一个面向项目级代码生成的以状态为中心的框架。 EvoCodeAgent维护一个由结构化项目规范初始化的演化架构状态，并持续将来自架构与骨架的预测关系与从生成代码中提取的实现关系进行协调。 它还利用基于工具的验证证据来支持可靠的状态更新，并从先前的修订尝试中抽象出可复用的修复经验，以指导后续生成。 在DevBench和CodeProjectEval等不同规模的项目级基准上进行的大量实验表明，EvoCodeAgent始终优于基线方法。 在GPT-5设置下，它分别达到60.48%和27.73%的单元测试通过率，相比最强基线提升高达53.5%。
